name: Data Processing Agreement
description: GDPR agreement defining controller and processor roles, subprocessor use, security measures, international transfers and breach notification.

coverPage.title: Data Processing Agreement
coverPage.intro: This Data Processing Agreement (the “Agreement”) consists of: (1) this Cover Page (“**Cover Page**”) and (2) the Common Paper Data Processing Agreement Standard Terms (“**Standard Terms**”). Any modifications of the Standard Terms should be made on the Cover Page, which will control over conflicts with the Standard Terms.
coverPage.attestation: By signing this Cover Page, each party agrees to enter into this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
coverPage.attribution: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement free to use under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

fields.label: Customer
fields.prompt: the controller's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address.

fields.label: Provider
fields.prompt: the processor's legal entity name, the signatory's name and title, and a notice address.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.prompt: the date the agreement starts, as yyyy-mm-dd.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.prompt: the underlying agreement this DPA attaches to.

fields.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
fields.prompt: what the provider does with the personal data and why, such as "hosting and analysing customer records to provide the Service".

fields.label: Duration of Processing
fields.prompt: how long the processing lasts, such as "for the term of the Agreement".

fields.label: Categories of Personal Data
fields.prompt: what kinds of personal data are processed, such as "names, email addresses and usage logs".

fields.label: Categories of Data Subjects
fields.prompt: whose personal data it is, such as "the customer's employees and end users".

fields.label: Special Category Data
fields.prompt: any special category data under GDPR Article 9, if any is processed. Usually none.

fields.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
fields.prompt: any extra safeguards for special category data. Usually none.

fields.label: Approved Subprocessors
fields.prompt: the subprocessors the customer has approved, with their country and what they do.

fields.label: Provider Security Contact
fields.prompt: an email address for the provider's security team.

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.prompt: where the provider's security policy can be read, such as a URL.

fields.label: Frequency of Transfer
fields.prompt: how often personal data is transferred, such as "continuously".

fields.label: Governing Member State
fields.prompt: the EU member state whose law governs the standard contractual clauses, such as "Ireland".
